type: Contemporary mechanism/risk-reduction screen; NOT original replication or executable account backtest
asset: SPY only; no alternative asset/window search
sample: 2007-01 through2007-12 warmup; 2008-01-02 through2023-12-29 scoring; all previously viewed development
signal: At each completed calendar month last session, adjusted total-return close > arithmetic mean of last10 completed month-end adjusted closes =>1; below=>0; equality retains prior state. Decision available only after close. Hold previous target until next trading session open. Initial target based on Dec2007 signal. No future month-end information.
return_accounting: Synthetic adjusted units; overnight prior close to next open earned by old position, open-to-close earned by new position, multiply segments. Cash return0, no leverage, shorts or financing. Cost5bps per side as adverse multiplicative price adjustment on exposure changes; stress10bps. Adjusted units include reinvestment; not actual dividend-cash accounting. No terminal sale required, mark to close.
comparators: Same5bps initial-entry buy-and-hold; fixed50% SPY/50% zero-yield cash daily constant-mix control (control ignores fees, conservative). Cash diagnostic.
primary: Risk reduction: at5bps realized maxDD <=75% buyhold maxDD, CAGR >=50% buyhold CAGR and >0; for stationary monthly blocks3/12/24, 5000 paired paths each seeds11003/11012/11024, lower95%CI for buyhold maxDD minus strategy maxDD >0. At10bps CAGR>0 and realizedDD reduction retained. No Sharpe/CAGR maximization/window choice.
monte_carlo: Resample aligned whole calendar-month daily-return chunks jointly across strategy/control/buyhold; compute daily compounded path drawdown and CAGR each path. Conditional fixed causal return streams, not new signal generation on synthetic prices. Report median/5th CAGR,95th maxDD. No independence claim.
risk_tiers: Report historical and resampled drawdown proxies for50/30/20 thresholds; no ranking admission from synthetic mechanism screen. Execution, independent confirmation and multiple-selection audit still required.
native_blocker: Original GFD total-return index and commercial-paper cash series not recovered; same-close original execution not reused
advance: Only if primary and stress gates pass, register raw-share $10000 execution test with dividend pay timing, costs/eligibility/session constraints and risk control audit.
